0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A hapless miner is having difficulty paying his tab.

24.original: Use the safety lamp south of Twine.

26.original: Give the safety lamp and sparkling gemstone to the hapless miner.

48.original: No more excuses! You'll not get another drop until you pay your tab!

49.original: But the gemstone I was gonna give you, I lost it on the way back from the mine! It was right there in my hands, I swear!

50.original: Then how'd you end up losing it? I don't care what you dug up, it won't be paying off your tab while it's sitting in some ditch.

51.original: I ain't makin' it up, honest!

52.original: Ah, you there! You don't look the sort to turn your back on a man who's down on his luck. Help me find it, would you?

53.original: Here, take this lantern. The gemstone'll glint when the light hits it. Bring it to me, and I'll...errr, think of some way to pay you back!

54.original: I've tried lookin' meself, but no joy. Why does nothin' ever go my way!?

55.original: You must be a fool to let yourself be caught up in one of his schemes. I don't think a true word's ever come out of his mouth.

56.original: Something is glimmering in the light of the lantern!

57.original: It seems the gemstone you seek is elsewhere.

60.original: Ahem! I think this should cover it.

61.original: It certainly does. But from now on, you'll pay up front for every drink. No more tabs!

62.original: I wonder if I'll be able to find any more stones like that? Folk at the Crystarium use them as lenses in some sort of magical cannons, so they sell for a hefty price.

63.original: If I manage to dig any more up, I'll take care not to drop 'em! Next time, I might not have someone like you around to help me! Many thanks to you, friend!
